An event that is generated by an application using a connection-oriented or connectionless protocol attempts to set the socket to the closed state. This event
is also generated when a session is inactive for 5 minutes using UDP. IPv6 is the source of the connection/connectionless protocol in this event. Note: this event
does not guarantee the communication between the two endpoints has ceased, but that a single socket has entered the closed state.
